sentence: If I would have more time, I would study more.
notes: Calque from si + tendría / si + aurais — would never appears in the if-clause.

sentence: It depends of the weather tomorrow.
notes: Calque from depender de / dépendre de.

sentence: We need to discuss about the contract terms.
notes: Discuss is directly transitive — no about.

sentence: I am interested by this job opportunity.
notes: Calque from interesado por / intéressé par.

sentence: She is married with a doctor.
notes: Calque from casado con / marié avec.

sentence: Let me give you an advice about the interview.
notes: Advice is uncountable — no indefinite article.

sentence: I need more informations about the patient.
notes: Uncountable nouns have no plural -s form.

sentence: I am interested in learning more about this program.
If I had more time, I would study more.
